title: GTA 6 Gets Unofficial Co-Op Mode with Proximity Voice Chat
description: GTA6 Hub reports on the latest GameRant news: an unauthorized mod reportedly brings online multiplayer, two-player co-op as Jason and Lucia, and proximity voice chat to GTA 6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Unofficial Co-Op Mod Emerges for GTA 6

As anticipation for Grand Theft Auto 6 remains at an all-time high across the global gaming community, modders are already looking for ways to expand the experience. According to a recent report by gaming outlet GameRant, an unauthorized mod has reportedly been developed to bring online multiplayer to Grand Theft Auto 6, allowing two players to team up.

## Playing as Jason and Lucia Together

The most notable aspect of this reported unofficial mod is its focus on cooperative gameplay. Rather than navigating the open-world environment alone, the mod allows two players to experience the game together, taking on the roles of the protagonists, Jason and Lucia. This dynamic opens up a new layer of potential for players who have been eager to share the open-world criminal adventures side-by-side.

In addition to the core two-player co-op functionality, the mod reportedly incorporates proximity voice chat. This feature allows players to communicate based on their relative in-game distance from one another, a mechanic that frequently enhances immersion and creates unique social interactions in modern multiplayer environments.

## Community Creativity vs. Official Boundaries

Mods have historically played a massive role in the longevity and culture surrounding Rockstar Games titles, from the PC days of GTA San Andreas to GTA 5. Communities have always pushed the technical boundaries to introduce features that developers may not have prioritized in the base campaign.

However, it is important to note that this project is an unauthorized, unofficial third-party mod. Because it does not stem from Rockstar Games, players should approach such modifications with an awareness of potential stability issues, rule compliance, and the unofficial nature of the content. While speculative interest in co-op modes for GTA 6 is high, official details regarding multiplayer features continue to be managed directly by the developer.

## Editor's Take

The emergence of an unofficial co-op mod for GTA 6 highlights the intense demand for multiplayer experiences featuring Jason and Lucia. Proximity voice chat is a fantastic addition for immersion. However, because this is an unauthorized third-party creation, players should remain cautious regarding stability and the unofficial status of the mod.
